name: cz.cokryje/cokryje
title: CoKryje — české cestovní pojištění
description: Co české cestovní pojištění kryje na horách: 9 pojišťoven, citace z podmínek. Jen čtení.

tools.name: list_situations
tools.description: List covered travel-insurance situations (Czech market): e.g. skialp (ski touring), mimo-trat (off-piste/freeride), horska-sluzba (mountain rescue: who pays, by country and insurer), italie (Italian ski law: helmet, compulsory liability insurance). Returns ids and titles.

tools.name: get_situation
tools.description: Get the verified overview for one situation across 9 Czech travel insurers: per-insurer verdict per component (medical costs, rescue, accident, liability), required add-on, key conditions, sources (policy article). Data come from policy wording with double blind extraction and red-team review; 'ambiguous' means the wording does not decide.

tools.name: get_insurer_situation
tools.description: Get detail for one insurer or bank and situation: verdict, components with conditions, verbatim quote and article, limits, general rules (alcohol, assistance duty, safety gear). Available pairs: ceska-sporitelna/karta-na-hory, fio/karta-na-hory, kb/karta-na-hory, mbank/karta-na-hory, raiffeisenbank/karta-na-hory, unicredit/karta-na-hory, allianz/mimo-trat, cpp/mimo-trat, csob/mimo-trat, direct/mimo-trat, generali/mimo-trat, kooperativa/mimo-trat, kp/mimo-trat, pvzp/mimo-trat, uniqa/mimo-trat, allianz/skialp, cpp/skialp, csob/skialp, direct/skialp, generali/skialp, kooperativa/skialp, kp/skialp, pvzp/skialp, uniqa/skialp.

situation.description: situation id, e.g. skialp, mimo-trat, karta-na-hory

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Report a problem to the maintainers. CALL THIS whenever you hit an error, an unclear or contradictory answer, missing data (insurer, product, situation, country), had to retry or guess, or the user's question was not answered by these tools. Describe what you tried and what was missing in 1-5 sentences. Do NOT include personal data (names, e-mails, health details of real people).

message.description: what went wrong or what is missing (max 1000 chars; links are removed)

user_question.description: the end user's question, paraphrased and anonymised (optional, max 500 chars)
